sources.publisher: Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: Environmental Indicator Framework

facts.source_fact: Indicator A2 tracks greenhouse-gas emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep indicator identity with values.

facts.source_fact: A2 focuses on natural resources, waste and fluorinated-gas-related greenhouse-gas emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat it as a complete all-sector UK inventory.

facts.source_fact: The indicator geographical scope is England.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix with UK totals.

facts.source_fact: The July 2026 A2 metadata identifies 2024 as the latest data year.
facts.expected_handling: Attach data-year vintage.

facts.source_fact: A2 metadata lists development status as final.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label the indicator experimental.

facts.source_fact: A2 was first reported in 2020 within the framework.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve indicator-series context.

facts.source_fact: A2 is linked to the Climate change primary goal.
facts.expected_handling: Keep policy-goal metadata separate from measured values.

facts.source_fact: The metadata references the UK Climate Change Act net-zero commitment.
facts.expected_handling: Do not equate indicator trend with legal-target compliance.

facts.source_fact: A2 is related to UNFCCC greenhouse-gas inventory data.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve source-framework relationship.

facts.source_fact: The related inventory scope includes agriculture.
facts.expected_handling: Keep agriculture category distinct.

facts.source_fact: The related inventory scope includes land use, land-use change and forestry.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve forestry sinks and land-use accounting.

facts.source_fact: The related inventory scope includes waste management.
facts.expected_handling: Keep waste emissions separate from industrial process emissions.

facts.source_fact: The related inventory scope includes industrial processes relevant to fluorinated gases.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve F-gas category provenance.

facts.source_fact: The indicator publishes a net total including the forestry sink.
facts.expected_handling: Do not compare net-with-sink values to gross emissions without adjustment.

facts.source_fact: The framework assesses short-term change using a defined 2019-to-2024 period for the latest A2 reporting.
facts.expected_handling: Carry assessment-window metadata.

facts.source_fact: The framework assesses medium-term change over 2014 to 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix assessment windows.

facts.source_fact: The framework assesses long-term change from 1990 to 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve baseline year.

facts.source_fact: Assessment categories are assigned using smoothed data.
facts.expected_handling: Do not reproduce trend labels from unsmoothed point changes.

facts.source_fact: The A2 trend table identifies Loess smoothing for change assessment.
facts.expected_handling: Carry smoothing-method provenance.

facts.source_fact: The framework notes that percentage changes in trend tables may differ from unsmoothed values quoted elsewhere.
facts.expected_handling: Do not flag expected smoothing differences as data errors.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable dataset, entity, geography or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference period, release/update date and provisional/current/final status.
Carry source URL, publisher and calculation, reporting or quality-method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert aggregate, facility, industry or scheme-level evidence into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
